content.title: 'Daredevil: Born Again' season 2 premiere time, date, how to watch
content.text: TVWhat time does 'Daredevil: Born Again' new season drop on Disney+? Manahil AhmadNorthJersey.comMarch 24, 2026, 8:52 a.m. ETKeep Watching“Daredevil: Born Again” returns for its second season on March 24, marking a new chapter for Marvel’s street-level superhero series on Disney+.The eight-episode season premieres Tuesday, at 9 p.m. Eastern. New episodes will drop weekly on Tuesday nights at the same time, with the season finale slated for May 12.The series continues to follow Matt Murdock, also known as Daredevil, as he faces off against his longtime adversary Wilson Fisk, also known as Kingpin. The new season centers on the escalating conflict between the two figures as tensions rise in New York’s criminal underworld.“Daredevil: Born Again” is part of Marvel’s expanding lineup of television projects on Disney+. It returns for its second season on Disney after three seasons of "Daredevil" on Netflix.Watch the MCU on Disney+Watch it here: Stream your favorite shows, the biggest blockbusters and more.Season 2 will run through mid-May, concluding the latest chapter in the long-running rivalry between Daredevil and Kingpin.Our team of savvy editors independently handpicks all recommendations.
